# DogsBay DITA tutorial — Optional modules

## Optional modules

- [Stage 08: Figures](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-dita-tutorial-docs/part-1-topics/stage-08-figures.md): Add a figure with an image and alt text, an inline SVG, an image map with clickable areas, and the decibel formula as MathML with a text fallback.
- [Stage 12: Glossary](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-dita-tutorial-docs/part-2-maps/stage-12-glossary.md): Add glossary entries and a glossary group with abbreviations, key them in a keydef map, and bind terms in the text to their definitions.
- [Stage 13: Metadata and index](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-dita-tutorial-docs/part-2-maps/stage-13-metadata-and-index.md): Give every topic a prolog with author, dates, audience, keywords and index terms, add publication metadata to the map, and enforce a metadata policy.
- [Stage 16: Branch filtering](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-dita-tutorial-docs/part-3-conditions/stage-16-branch-filtering.md): Publish the install task three times from one map, once per platform, with a ditavalref on the branch and a prefix or suffix on the copies.
- [Stage 17: Key scopes](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-dita-tutorial-docs/part-3-conditions/stage-17-key-scopes.md): Give each guide its own start-here key, publish all three guides in one collection without key collisions, and link across deliverables with a peer map.
- [Stage 18: Chunking and output](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-dita-tutorial-docs/part-3-conditions/stage-18-chunking-and-output.md): Combine output pages, test splitting in a separate example, and control publication names and visibility.
- [Stage 19: Bookmap](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-dita-tutorial-docs/part-4-books/stage-19-bookmap.md): Publish the guide as a PDF book with a bookmap, book metadata, front matter, parts, chapters, appendixes, a glossary list and an index.
- [Stage 20: Troubleshooting](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-dita-tutorial-docs/part-4-books/stage-20-troubleshooting.md): Write a troubleshooting topic with a condition, causes and remedies, and turn a warning in the recording task into a trouble note that points at it.
- [Stage 21: Hazards and safety](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-dita-tutorial-docs/part-4-books/stage-21-hazards-and-safety.md): Create a hazard statement with a message panel and symbol, then reuse it in the recording task with conkeyref.
- [Stage 22: Software domains](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-dita-tutorial-docs/part-4-books/stage-22-software-domains.md): Document a command-line interface with the software and programming domains, a syntax diagram, a parameter list, messages, and code pulled from a file.
- [Stage 23: Learning](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-dita-tutorial-docs/part-4-books/stage-23-learning.md): Create a learning assessment with four question types and configure the gate to validate it with the DITA-OT catalog.
- [Stage 24: Drafts and localization](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-dita-tutorial-docs/part-5-governance/stage-24-drafts-and-localization.md): Mark the guide for review and translation with a language on every root, translate flags, a right-to-left phrase, sort keys, review markup and a change history.
